summary: The discussion addressed the integration of network layer inputs with OAM systems, emphasizing a focus on measuring CATS system performance rather than managing existing network plumbing. Security considerations for CAS version 4 were then presented, identifying risks such as man-in-the-middle attacks, fake instance registration, and denial-of-service threats within functional components like the service metric agent. Recommendations included deploying these agents in trusted zones behind firewalls and enforcing rate limiting to mitigate malicious requests.
